nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address stored in contract storage; target of constructor and transferOwnership writes.
Claimable.pendingOwner: address proposed to become owner, finalized by claimOwnership.
GlobalPause.allTokensPaused: global pause flag written by pauseAllTokens and read by requireNotPaused.
GlobalPause.pauseNotice: notice string written by pauseAllTokens and used as revert reason.
Ownable() constructor: initializes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
modifier onlyOwner: requires msg.sender == owner, the access-control gate for privileged functions.
modifier onlyPendingOwner: requires msg.sender == pendingOwner, gate for claimOwnership.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: emits event and sets owner = newOwner.
Claimable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: sets pendingOwner = newOwner instead of transferring directly.
Claimable.claimOwnership() onlyPendingOwner: promotes pendingOwner to owner and clears pendingOwner.
GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens(bool _status, string _notice) onlyOwner: mutates global pause flag and notice.
GlobalPause.requireNotPaused() view: reverts with pauseNotice when allTokensPaused is true.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership initialization and all access-control checks.
Assignment owner = msg.sender in the Ownable constructor: unauthenticated caller becomes owner.
Assignment owner = newOwner in Ownable.transferOwnership: privileged state-variable overwrite.
Assignment pendingOwner = newOwner in Claimable.transferOwnership: sets pending privileged address.
State updates owner = pendingOwner and pendingOwner = address(0) in claimOwnership: finalizes ownership handover.
Assignments allTokensPaused = _status and pauseNotice = _notice in pauseAllTokens: privileged pause-state mutation.
Parameter newOwner of Ownable.transferOwnership: attacker-influenceable destination of ownership.
Parameter newOwner of Claimable.transferOwnership: proposed pending owner address.
Parameter _status of GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens: new value of the global pause flag.
Parameter _notice of GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens: new pause notice string.

edges.reason: msg.sender is copied into the owner state variable by the constructor assignment.
The constructor assignment writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
The Ownable constructor executes the owner = msg.sender assignment unconditionally.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to validate msg.sender equality.
onlyOwner uses the untrusted msg.sender in its require check to gate privileged functions.
onlyPendingOwner reads pendingOwner to validate msg.sender equality.
onlyPendingOwner uses the untrusted msg.sender in its require check.
onlyOwner modifier guards entry into Ownable.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards entry into Claimable.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards entry into GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens.
onlyPendingOwner modifier guards entry into claimOwnership.
Claimable.transferOwnership overrides Ownable.transferOwnership, replacing the direct ownership transfer path.
The newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership flows into the owner assignment.
Ownable.transferOwnership executes the owner = newOwner privileged assignment.
owner = newOwner overwrites the owner state variable and thereby the access-control authority.
The newOwner parameter of Claimable.transferOwnership flows into the pendingOwner assignment.
Claimable.transferOwnership executes the pendingOwner = newOwner assignment.
pendingOwner = newOwner writes the pending privileged address state variable.
claimOwnership reads pendingOwner to promote it to owner.
claimOwnership executes the ownership state updates.
claimOwnership performs owner = pendingOwner, transferring full access-control authority.
claimOwnership resets pendingOwner to address(0).
_status flows into the allTokensPaused state-variable assignment.
_notice flows into the pauseNotice state-variable assignment.
pauseAllTokens, restricted by onlyOwner, executes the pause-state writes.
allTokensPaused = _status mutates the global pause flag controlling all tokens.
pauseNotice = _notice mutates the stored pause notice string.
requireNotPaused reads allTokensPaused inside its require statement.
requireNotPaused uses pauseNotice as the revert reason string.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership has no independent behavior and only serves as the source value of the owner = newOwner state write, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The newOwner parameter of Claimable.transferOwnership only supplies the value written to pendingOwner and merges into that unsafe state assignment.
The _status parameter is only consumed by the allTokensPaused = _status assignment and merges into the pause-state unsafe operation.
The _notice parameter is only consumed by the pauseNotice = _notice assignment and merges into the same pause-state unsafe operation.
